id: title:jurajmajerik:include excluded variants in daily timeseries fingerprints

review.posthog_relevance: Adds an `excluded_variants` parameter to HogQL query execution and fingerprint computation for experiment and saved metrics, potentially excluding specific variants from metric calculations and including them in fingerprints.
review.reason: The change adds a parameter, `excluded_variants`, to HogQL query execution and fingerprint computation for experiment and saved metrics. This could potentially exclude specific variants from metric calculations and include them in fingerprints. The exact behavior depends on the HogQL implementation.
review.uncertainty: The exact behavior of the HogQL implementation is not provided, so the exact impact of the change is not known.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a parameter, excluded_variants, to the hourly sync calls for regular and saved experiment metrics.
observations.posthog_connection: This parameter is passed to the HogQL query execution, potentially excluding specific variants from the metric calculation, though the exact exclusion behavior depends on the HogQL implementation.

observations.behavior: Adds the same excluded_variants parameter to the saved metrics hourly sync call.
observations.posthog_connection: This parameter is passed to the HogQL query execution for saved metrics, potentially excluding specific variants from the metric calculation.

observations.behavior: Adds a new test class and two tests to verify that the fingerprint computation for experiment metrics includes the excluded_variants parameter.
observations.posthog_connection: This parameter is passed to the fingerprint computation, potentially including the excluded variants in the fingerprint, though the exact fingerprint behavior depends on the HogQL implementation.
